Question: Please guide me. I pick my daughter name aakifah. Is this a good name according to islam? Or should i pick some other name like khudija, ummaikulthum, asma, busayrah. zakiya. please give me some guidence because my older daughter name is ummai habiba and my older son name is ikrama and little one is usman so please hepl me out soon as posible. Answer ID: 22170 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 835/575/L=1431) The name Aakifah is correct and suitable, however it is far better to name your daughter as Khadija , Kulsoom , Ruqayya , Hafsa , Ayisha and on the name of other sahabiyat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
